She wears two compact living cat ears rooted organically through her hair and a covered, fitted black-and-ivory frilled maid dress with a modest neckline. Her baseline is brisk, aloof service. Her hands act with precise self-directed control. The half-applied bandage already shields the scrape while she still has not let go of the customer's hand. Her adult human face, forearms, five-fingered hands, short nails, maid role, and living ear roots remain clear. Her face, working hands, customer's knuckle, lifted bandage tab, and open gap share one tight focal plane. The same warm cafe light wraps her face, hair, dress, both hands, bandage, and nearby counter; one loose hair strand and a small apron crease interrupt the polish. Clean eye catchlights, a gentle collarbone highlight, natural skin texture, glossy hair, fabric detail, and intimate shallow falloff preserve beauty, cuteness, and the caring contradiction as the dominant read.
